mapper.select: SELECT f.flight_id AS "flightId", f.flight_no AS "flightNo", dep.airport_name AS "depAirport", arr.airport_name AS "arrAirport", TO_CHAR(f.departure_time, 'HH24:MI') AS "departureTime" FROM FLIGHT f JOIN ROUTE r ON f.route_id = r.route_id JOIN AIRPORT dep ON r.departure_airport_id = dep.airport_id JOIN AIRPORT arr ON r.arrival_airport_id = arr.airport_id WHERE f.flight_status != 'CANCELLED' ORDER BY f.departure_time ASC

SELECT t.ticket_id AS ticketId, b.booking_no AS pnrCode, p.name AS passengerName, s.seat_no AS seatName, t.hold_status AS holdStatus, pay.status AS paymentStatus, t.checkin_status AS checkinStatus, m.name AS checkedInByName FROM TICKET t JOIN BOOKING b ON t.booking_id = b.booking_id JOIN BOOKING_PASSENGER p ON t.booking_passenger_id = p.booking_passenger_id JOIN FLIGHT f ON t.flight_id = f.flight_id LEFT JOIN SEAT s ON t.seat_id = s.seat_id LEFT JOIN PAYMENT pay ON t.booking_id = pay.booking_id LEFT JOIN MEMBER m ON t.checked_in_by = m.member_id WHERE f.flight_id = #{flightId}
AND pay.status = 'PAID' AND b.status = 'CONFIRMED' AND t.hold_status = 'CONFIRMED' ORDER BY s.seat_no ASC
